name: Owwly

sources.title: Product index — Angular SPA ('Owwly - Ultimate AI tools list'), Stripe.js loaded for paid promotion
Promotion PDF — paid options: newsletter feature $29, 'land on the top' $179/wk–$659/mo, promo day $99–$129
Third-party submission guide — free submission, account registration required, manual review ~3–7 days, no backlink or CAPTCHA

conditions: Free submission exists but requires account registration; third-party reports manual review of ~3–7 days
requirements: AI tools and indie products — 'everyone can contribute to our AI tools list. Simply add your product'
Free tier is a plain listing; paid promotion (featured day, newsletter slot, top placement) is a separate menu
preparation: Product name, short description, category (site uses playful category tags like 🦄 AI, 🏀 Illustrations, 🍎 Apple)
Cover image (JPG/GIF options mentioned for promos)
workflow: Register on owwly.com (JS app — needs a real browser)
Add your product via the submission flow
Free listing waits for manual review (~3–7 days per third-party guide)
Paid options if wanted: newsletter feature ~$29, 'land on the top' $179–$659, promo day ~$99–$129
watchFor: Site is fully JS-rendered — no plain-HTML form; automation needs a browser
Stripe is integrated — expect paid upsells inside the submit flow
Marketing is indie-hacker flavored ('land on the top'); paid placements are the business model, so free listings may be deprioritized
Third-party reports no backlink requirement and no CAPTCHA
countsAsLive: The product appears in https://owwly.com/products/all or its category with a /product/<slug>-<id> detail page
unknowns: Whether free listings still get approved promptly (review-staff dependency)
Whether outbound links are dofollow (third-party claims dofollow)
Exact free-form field list inside the app
